messages.text: Happy to help with that. What's the order number, and either the name it ships to or the postcode?
Thanks. One more thing to pull it up: the email on the order.

Got it, your B30 and Power Kit are paid and unshipped. The B30 ships November 14.

Before we talk cancelling, what changed for you? If it's the wait, I've got options that don't cost you anything.
Need the money right now will buy a little later when I have more money

Understood, cash comes first. Two things before you decide.

Cancelling an unshipped pre-sale carries a 10% restocking fee, so $839 comes back as $755.10. And the B30 is $899 today, so buying again later costs more than you paid and lands in a later batch.

If it helps in the meantime, I can put $50 back on your card now and leave the order as it is. Want me to do that instead?
Handed to the team · refund/cancellation needs a person to move the money

That's fair, I'll get it moving. Cancelling Shop···· returns $755.10 to the card you paid with, after the 10% pre-sale restocking fee. The money lands 3 to 5 business days after it's issued.

Abel or Georges has been pinged and one of them will jump into this chat, so stay with me if you can. If you step away, the confirmation comes to your email.
Restocking for what it hasn’t even moved
Handed to the team · customer disputes the 10% restocking fee on an unshipped pre-sale; waiver is not

I hear you. The fee is there because a pre-order holds a unit in the batch at the factory, so the slot is paid for on our side even though nothing left the warehouse yet.

Waiving it isn't mine to do. I've put that question in front of Abel and Georges along with the cancellation, so they decide the final amount. Stay in the chat and one of them will pick it up here.

Thanks for bearing with me. They're on until 6pm Eastern today, so it should be soon. A copy of this whole conversation goes to your email once we're done here, so you'll have the numbers in writing either way.
